geneExpressionTiles.name: label
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: A human-readable label for this level (e.g. 'bin20').

geneExpressionTiles.name: bin_size
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The edge length of one pixel of this level, in base pixel units. 1 is the native resolution. Must appear in the parent geneExpressionPyramid's bin_sizes.

geneExpressionTiles.name: pixel_size_x
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The physical size of one pixel of this level in x, in pixel_size_units. Equal to bin_size * the parent's base_pixel_size_x.

geneExpressionTiles.name: pixel_size_y
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The physical size of one pixel of this level in y, in pixel_size_units.

geneExpressionTiles.name: pixel_size_units
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The units of pixel_size_x and pixel_size_y.

geneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_order
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The order of the dimensions of this level. Follows the imageStack_parameters convention; G denotes the gene dimension.

geneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_labels
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The labels of each dimension as a comma-separated list, in dimension_order.

geneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_size
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The length of each dimension in dimension_order, e.g. [n_rows_of_pixels, n_columns_of_pixels, n_genes] for the whole level (not per tile).

geneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_scale
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The scale of each dimension in dimension_order, in dimension_scale_units, e.g. [pixel_size_y, pixel_size_x, 1].

geneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_scale_units
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The units of each dimension as a comma-separated list, in dimension_order.

geneExpressionTiles.name: tile_size_x_bins
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The width of one tile, in pixels of THIS level (not base pixels). Tiles on the right edge may be partially filled if extent_x is not an exact multiple.

geneExpressionTiles.name: tile_size_y_bins
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The height of one tile, in pixels of THIS level. Tiles on the bottom edge may be partially filled.

geneExpressionTiles.name: n_tiles_stored
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The number of tile files actually written. May be less than tile_rows*tile_columns because tiles containing no data are omitted; use ndi.document/current_file_list to discover which exist.

geneExpressionTiles.name: data_type_gene_index
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The integer type of the gene_index array in each tile. Values index rows of the parent's genes.tsv.

geneExpressionTiles.name: data_type_count
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The integer type of the count array in each tile.

geneExpressionTiles.name: data_type_offset
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The integer type of the offset (row pointer) array in each tile.

geneExpressionTiles.name: data_type_coordinate
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The integer type of the tile-local x and y coordinate arrays in each tile.

geneExpressionTiles.name: tile_compression
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The compression applied to each tile file as a whole: 'none' or 'gzip'.

geneExpressionTiles.name: tile_format_version
geneExpressionTiles.documentation: The version of the tile binary layout. See geneExpressionTiles.md.
